title: Office of public guardian; establishment; appointment.
bodyText: There is established the office of the public guardian in the judiciary. The chief justice shall appoint the public guardian, who shall serve at the chief justice's pleasure.
bodyHtml: [§551A-1]  Office of public guardian; establishment; appointment.  There is established the office of the public guardian in the judiciary.  The chief justice shall appoint the public guardian, who shall serve at the chief justice's pleasure. [L 1984, c 223, pt of §1]
